Python implementation
df["Timestamp"] = pd.to_datetime(df["Timestamp"]) df["Amount EUR"] = pd.to_numeric(df["Amount EUR"]) df["Risk Score"] = pd.to_numeric(df["Risk Score"]) df["Review Priority"] = pd.cut( df["Risk Score"], [-1, 51, 69, 84, 100], labels=["Routine", "Medium", "High", "Critical"] )
Documentation & limitations
What it does

Prioritises transaction-monitoring workload using transparent signals.

What it does not do

It does not prove criminal activity or make a legal determination.

Production path

Connect secure transaction feeds, validated models, case management and audit controls.

Portfolio disclosure: synthetic data and illustrative risk rules are used. No real customer or bank data is included.
